title: [AUG-16] Make session rename discoverable with edit icon
why_we_need_this: Renaming a session requires double-clicking the title — a hidden gesture with no visual cue. The delete button shows on hover, but rename has no equivalent affordance. Users never discover this feature.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A pencil/edit icon appears on hover next to the delete × button on each session item
- [ ] Clicking the edit icon enters rename mode (same behavior as current double-click)
- [ ] Double-click on title still works as a secondary trigger
- [ ] Edit icon uses sidebar color scheme and matches delete button styling (opacity transition on hover)
- [ ] Edit icon is keyboard-accessible (focusable, activates on Enter)
